# Municipal Ordinance No. 07, Series of 2003

**Curfew Ordinance for Children and Youth Below Eighteen (18) Years of Age**

## Summary

This ordinance declares a curfew for children and youth below eighteen (18) years of age from 9:00 PM to 4:00 AM. It aims to protect them from exploitation and harmful influences, instill discipline, and provide them with more time for school and family responsibilities. The ordinance prescribes penalties for violations and establishes a Barangay Curfew Enforcement Council.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Declares the hours from 9:00 PM to 4:00 AM as curfew hours for children and youth below eighteen (18) years of age.
2.  **Section 2.** Prohibits children and youth below eighteen (18) years of age from being in streets, commercial establishments, recreation centers, or any other area outside the immediate vicinity of their residence during curfew hours, with exceptions for those accompanied by parents/family members, those running lawful errands, students of night schools, and those working at night with proper documentation.
3.  **Section 3.** Authorizes Barangay Tanods to apprehend and hold violators of the curfew for not more than three (3) hours.
4.  **Section 4.** Requires the apprehending official to notify the parent or guardian of the apprehended child.
5.  **Section 5.** Specifies sanctions and penalties for violations, including reprimands, admonition, counseling, and imprisonment or fines for repeat offenders.
6.  **Section 6.** Establishes a "Barangay Curfew Enforcement Council" in every Barangay.
7.  **Section 7.** Mandates a "Barangay Council for the Protection of the Welfare of the Youth/Children".
8.  **Section 8.** Requires the Secretary of the Barangay to record and maintain a separate permanent list of the name, address, date of birth, time and place of apprehension, and other circumstances of every child and youth apprehended.
9.  **Section 9.** Grants the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] the power to suspend the implementation of the Ordinance in particular Barangays or specific areas.
10. **Section 10.** Directs the Local Police Chief to make available resources to the Local Force to Punong Barangays in the enforcement of this Ordinance.
11. **Section 11.** Requires copies of this Ordinance to be posted in the barangay Hall and in at least 3 conspicuous places.
12. **Section 12.** Requires the Barangay to warn children and youth about the curfew upon its imposition through warning whistle, public address system, or the like, at 9 p.m.
13. **Section 13.** Designates the Local Department of Social Welfare and Development shall be the primary agency charged with monitoring and implementation hereof.
14. **Section 14.** States that if any reason, any part or provision of this Ordinance shall be held to be unconstitutional or invalid, other parts or provisions hereof, which are not affected thereby, shall continue to be in full force and effect.
15. **Section 15.** Repeals any Municipality or Barangay Ordinance or parts thereof inconsistent herewith.
16. **Section 16.** States that this Ordinance shall take effect thirty (30) days after its approval.
